summary: fix(settings): expect firefox-logo-bw.svg in ScanQR test
description:
Because:

- The ScanQR component imports firefox-logo-bw.svg, but its test still
  expected firefox-logo-browser.svg, so the frontend test job failed.

This commit:

- Changes the expected data-logo value in the ScanQR test to
  firefox-logo-bw.svg.

Closes FXA-14770
